Drop the source artefact into the anomaly named by its recipe.

The four consecutive stages take %c[255,170,220,170]30%c[default], %c[255,105,185,235]40%c[default], %c[255,190,125,225]50%c[default] and %c[255,235,145,145]60 in-game minutes%c[default].

The outcome is fixed and saved when cooking starts; loading a save does not change it. No mutant parts or other items are required.

Identifies real anomalies within 10 metres and displays their names at the base of each danger zone. Radioactive fields are not marked.

Professor, what exactly is a mesomodificat, and where am I supposed to find one?

Cooking begins with a natural class-IV base, followed by a modificat, mesomodificat, hypermodificat and Absolute. These four stages do not occur naturally; they are produced through sequential anomaly treatments. Our expedition has verified protocols.
I understand now. Thank you, Professor.
Professor, I would like to purchase the artefact-modification protocols.
Certainly. You will have to pay for the research materials. Which family interests you?
The following protocol is currently available for this branch:
I am interested in another family.
A first-stage protocol will cost you 2,000 rubles.
A second-stage protocol will cost you 4,000 rubles.
A third-stage protocol will cost you 7,000 rubles.
A fourth-stage protocol will cost you 11,000 rubles.
I do not have that much right now.
Done. I transferred the protocol to your PDA; the recipe is now in the encyclopedia.

I know where another red stash lies, and I can show you the way.

In return, bring me five modificats, three mesomodificats, or two hypermodificats. One Absolute will also suffice.

I will not touch what you wear on your belt. Choose your payment.
The laboratory needs a stable medical-field modificat to calibrate its portable diagnostic equipment. Only a specimen produced by a known protocol will be accepted.
A radiological test series is about to begin, but its reference specimen has failed. Spectrum will pay extra for a replacement delivered before the instruments are started.
The scientists are comparing medical and protective fields in second-stage structures. They need a single mesomodificat with a confirmed preparation protocol.
A scarce mesosample is required to check the shielding of a new radiological unit. The laboratory is ready to pay above its usual rate for this specific class of structure.
Spectrum has opened a classified series on extreme medical and protective fields. A third-stage hypermodificat is required for the final measurement cycle.
The institute is assembling a test energy circuit and needs a first-stage thermal or electrical modificat. The specimen must match a protocol already registered in the PDA.
The thermal test bed is scheduled to start within a day, but its working sample was damaged. The researchers promise an urgent-delivery premium for a replacement.
A second-stage structure is needed for prolonged heating and discharge trials. Thermosphere will accept one documented thermal or electrical mesomodificat.
The institute lacks a stable energy core for a high-load experiment. A suitable mesomodificat is scarce, so the procurement budget has been increased.
The engineers are preparing the thermal chamber for its limit regime. Only a third-stage hypermodificat can sustain the planned temperature and electrical loads.
The group is renewing the protective circle around its field camp. It needs one first-stage modificat that affects physical load, carrying capacity, or the flow of time.
The next caravan leaves within a day, and its portable field set is still incomplete. Three Candles will pay extra for a suitable modificat delivered before departure.
The group is preparing a field trial of second-stage physical and temporal structures. One mesomodificat from a known recipe is required for comparison.
A rare portable mesosample is needed for a long route through the Zone. Its effects on load and time will be measured away from laboratory equipment.
The senior circle is preparing an experiment with extreme physical and temporal distortion. It requires one third-stage hypermodificat obtained by a verified protocol.
Yakov is assembling a comparative set of adaptations found in common mutants. He needs blind dog tails, flesh eyes and a boar hoof together with a stable artefact.
Yakov needs fresh meat samples from small and medium mutants for a new preservation series. An artefact will provide the background field for observing tissue changes.
The collector is comparing the effects of anomalous mutation in snorks and bloodsuckers. He will take a snork hand, a bloodsucker jaw and one ordinary artefact.
Yakov is comparing tissue from hoofed and canine mutants. He needs boar and pseudodog samples along with an artefact for the control field.
The collector is preparing a closed display devoted to the Zone's deadliest predators. He needs one bloodsucker tissue sample, one chimera tissue sample and a stable artefact.
Yakov is studying traces of psi influence in the tissues of sentient mutants. He needs a burer hand, a controller hand and an ordinary artefact.
A separate specimen jar requires an intact controller organ. The artefact will act as a stabilizer during storage.
Yakov is assembling a complete pseudogiant tissue set. He needs an eye, a paw and one ordinary artefact for comparative analysis.
The collector is looking for a second kind of chimera trophy for a comparative display. He needs one rare claw and one ordinary artefact; Yakov is not asking for extras.
